description:
This file provides platform-dependent and utility functions for the Lpcco Tcp Object, primarily including a factory function for creating an instance of the object.
It includes licensing information, module description, and a single function definition, AnscCreateLpccoTcp, which calls a creation function for the Tcp object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateLpccoTcp(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Lpcco Tcp object and returns its handle by calling the internal creation function.
